full_judgment: 2. The case of the appellant, in short, was that one Syed Manjurul Hoque took lease of the property mentioned above from the Government by registered deed of lease dated 24.7.1953. Syed Manjurul Hoque transferred the disputed property to one Syed Yousuf on 20.06.1974. Said Syed Yousuf Ali, in his tern, sold the same to the appellant by sale deed dated 24.06.1975. The appellant mutated her name in the Khatian and paid rent to the Government. The property was enlisted in the 'Kha' list of the abandoned properties. Accordingly, the appellant filed aforesaid Settlement case. The court of Settlement by the judgment and order dated 16.09.2001 dismissed the case. The appellant then filed Writ Petition No. 3617 of 2002 which was rejected summarily. Then the appellant preferred this appeal after getting leave.
